decisions.reason: Training builds directly on existing know-how and customer relationships, so the firm can readily absorb and improve it.
The rotary axis accessory is closely related to existing milling systems, allowing the firm to leverage its accumulated knowledge.
Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm's core milling and dispensing knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve the product.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is central to the firm's established capabilities and product line, so absorptive capacity is high.
Automatic tool change systems build on existing machining expertise, enabling the firm to learn from and enhance the product.
